title: 🔥 ANNE ASKEW: BURNED ALIVE FOR REJECTING THE CATHOLIC MASS—A MARTYR FOR CHRIST
paragraphs:
🔥 ANNE ASKEW: BURNED ALIVE FOR REJECTING THE CATHOLIC MASS—A MARTYR FOR CHRIST
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I heard about Anne Askew, a woman who was tortured and burned alive for rejecting the Catholic Mass. Why was she persecuted, and what was her belief about the Lord’s Supper?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people today do not realize that the Roman Catholic Church brutally persecuted those who rejected their false doctrines. Anne Askew was a bold woman of faith who stood against the heresy of transubstantiation—and paid for it with her life.

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
🚨 THE TRUTH: ANNE ASKEW WAS A FAITHFUL CHRISTIAN WHO DIED FOR THE PURE GOSPEL!

✔️ She was one of the first English women to stand against the Catholic doctrine of transubstantiation.
✔️ She rejected the Mass as an unbiblical, man-made tradition.
✔️ She was tortured on the rack—the only woman in English history to suffer this.
✔️ She was burned at the stake for refusing to renounce her faith in Christ alone!
🔥 LET’S BREAK THIS DOWN WITH SCRIPTURE, HISTORY, AND TRUTH!
WHAT WAS THE FALSE TEACHING OF TRANSUBSTANTIATION THAT ANNE ASKEW REJECTED?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what exactly is transubstantiation, and why did Anne Askew reject it?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Transubstantiation is one of the most dangerous lies of the Roman Catholic Church. It teaches that during the Mass, the bread and wine literally become the body and blood of Christ. This belief contradicts Scripture and replaces the true Gospel with a false, man-made ritual.

📖 Hebrews 10:10 (KJV)
"By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all."
🚨 THE TRUTH: CHRIST’S SACRIFICE WAS ONCE AND FOR ALL—IT IS NOT REPEATED IN THE MASS!

✔️ Transubstantiation falsely claims that Jesus is "re-sacrificed" at every Mass.
✔️ The Bible teaches that Jesus’ sacrifice was finished on the cross (John 19:30).
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does it say that priests have the power to transform bread into Christ’s body.
🔥 ANNE ASKEW REJECTED THIS BLASPHEMY AND STOOD FOR BIBLICAL TRUTH!

📖 1 Corinthians 11:24-25 (KJV)
"And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me. After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me."
🚨 THE TRUTH: THE LORD’S SUPPER IS SYMBOLIC—NOT A LITERAL RE-SACRIFICE!

✔️ Jesus said, ‘Do this in remembrance of Me’—not as a repeated sacrifice.
✔️ The bread and wine are symbols of His body and blood—not a literal transformation.
✔️ Anne Askew knew that the Catholic Mass was a deception that enslaved people under false teachings.
🔥 BECAUSE OF HER FAITHFUL STAND, SHE WAS MARKED FOR EXECUTION!
HOW WAS ANNE ASKEW ARRESTED, TORTURED, AND SENTENCED TO DEATH?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how did the Catholic authorities treat Anne Askew? Why did they torture and kill her?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Anne Askew was a faithful woman of God who refused to bow to Catholic lies. Because of this, the religious authorities of England, still under the influence of Rome, sought to silence her through brutal torture and execution.

📖 Matthew 24:9 (KJV)
"Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake."
🚨 THE TRUTH: THE CATHOLIC CHURCH PERSECUTED TRUE CHRISTIANS WHO REJECTED THEIR FALSE TEACHINGS!

✔️ Anne was arrested in 1545 for distributing biblical materials and rejecting the Mass.
✔️ She boldly preached salvation through faith in Christ alone.
✔️ Catholic officials demanded that she renounce her beliefs—but she refused.
🔥 TORTURED ON THE RACK—THE ONLY WOMAN IN ENGLISH HISTORY TO SUFFER THIS!

📖 Mark 13:13 (KJV)
"And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved."
🚨 THE HORROR OF HER TORTURE:

✔️ Anne was stretched on the rack—a brutal device that pulled her joints out of place.
✔️ She was interrogated about Protestant leaders, but she refused to betray them.
✔️ Even after extreme pain, she stood firm in her faith!
🔥 SENTENCED TO DEATH—SHE REFUSED TO DENY CHRIST!

📖 Revelation 2:10 (KJV)
"Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life."

✔️ Anne was sentenced to be burned at the stake for rejecting the Mass.
✔️ She was carried to her execution because she could no longer walk after the torture.
✔️ Even in her final moments, she prayed and proclaimed Christ as Lord.
🚨 THE CATHOLIC CHURCH BURNED HER ALIVE TO SILENCE HER—BUT HER TESTIMONY STILL SPEAKS TODAY!
🔥 HER LAST WORDS WERE A TESTIMONY OF UNWAVERING FAITH!
DOES THE ORIGINAL GREEK AND HEBREW TEXT CONFIRM THAT THE CATHOLIC MASS IS A DECEPTION?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, does the original Greek and Hebrew text prove that the Catholic Mass is unbiblical?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Bible was originally written in Hebrew (Old Testament) and Greek (New Testament), and when we examine these texts, we find that the Catholic doctrine of transubstantiation directly contradicts God’s Word.

📖 Hebrews 9:28 (KJV)
"So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation."
🚨 THE TRUTH: JESUS’ SACRIFICE WAS ONCE FOR ALL—IT CANNOT BE REPEATED!

✔️ Greek word for ‘once’ = ἅπαξ (hapax) – Meaning: one time, never to be repeated.
✔️ Greek word for ‘offered’ = προσφέρω (prospherō) – Meaning: to present a sacrifice before God.
✔️ Greek word for ‘without sin’ = χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας (chōris hamartias) – Meaning: Jesus’ sacrifice was perfect and final!
🔥 THE BIBLE CLEARLY SAYS CHRIST’S SACRIFICE DOES NOT NEED TO BE REPEATED!

📖 Hebrews 10:12 (KJV)
"But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God."
🚨 COMPARE THIS TO THE CATHOLIC MASS:

✔️ Catholicism teaches that Christ is "re-sacrificed" at every Mass.
✔️ The Bible says Jesus’ sacrifice was ONCE and NEVER to be repeated.
✔️ Catholicism contradicts Scripture and turns the Mass into a false offering!
🔥 ANNE ASKEW UNDERSTOOD THIS TRUTH AND DIED FOR IT!

📖 John 19:30 (KJV)
"When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost."

✔️ Greek word for ‘finished’ = τετέλεσται (tetelestai) – Meaning: PAID IN FULL, COMPLETED FOREVER!
✔️ This proves that the Catholic Mass is a deception—it denies the finished work of Christ!
🚨 THE CATHOLIC MASS DENIES JESUS’ OWN WORDS!
🔥 ANNE ASKEW STOOD ON THE WORD OF GOD, AND SO MUST WE!
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHECY CONNECTION—WAS ANNE ASKEW’S MARTYRDOM FORETOLD IN SCRIPTURE?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, does the Bible foretell the persecution of true believers like Anne Askew? Were her sufferings part of God’s prophetic plan?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Old Testament clearly prophesied that God’s faithful followers would be persecuted and even killed for standing for His truth. Anne Askew was not alone—her martyrdom was part of a long history of God's people suffering for righteousness' sake.

📖 Psalm 116:15 (KJV)
"Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints."
🚨 THE TRUTH: GOD KNEW HIS FAITHFUL SERVANTS WOULD BE PERSECUTED—AND HE HONORS THEM!

✔️ The Bible foretold that the righteous would suffer at the hands of religious leaders.
✔️ Anne Askew’s death was not in vain—it was a testimony to the world.
✔️ God values His martyrs, and their reward is eternal!

📖 Daniel 7:25 (KJV)
"And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws."
🔥 THIS PROPHECY DESCRIBES EXACTLY WHAT CATHOLICISM DID!

✔️ "Wear out the saints"—Catholicism tortured and killed true believers like Anne Askew.
✔️ "Think to change times and laws"—The Catholic Church changed the Sabbath, created false sacraments, and invented the Mass.
✔️ Anne Askew stood against these false teachings, fulfilling this prophecy!

📖 Isaiah 29:13 (KJV)
"Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men."
🚨 THIS DESCRIBES RELIGIOUS HYPOCRISY—THE SAME SYSTEM THAT PERSECUTED ANNE ASKEW!

✔️ The Catholic Church honored God with their lips but denied Him with their false doctrines.
✔️ They created man-made traditions instead of following the pure Gospel.
✔️ Anne Askew exposed these lies—and she was killed for it!
🔥 HER MARTYRDOM WAS NOT A TRAGEDY—IT WAS A TESTIMONY TO THE POWER OF GOD!

📖 Revelation 6:9-11 (KJV)
"And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held... And white robes were given unto every one of them."

✔️ Anne Askew is among the saints who were slain for the Word of God.
✔️ Her reward in heaven is far greater than anything this world could offer!
✔️ We must be ready to stand for truth, just as she did!
🚨 GOD’S PROPHECIES WERE FULFILLED—AND HIS CALL TO DEFEND THE TRUTH STILL STANDS TODAY!
FINAL CHALLENGE—WILL YOU STAND FOR THE TRUTH LIKE ANNE ASKEW, OR BOW TO RELIGIOUS DECEPTION?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, Anne Askew stood firm against false teachings and was willing to die for the truth. What does that mean for us today? Are we also called to take a stand?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The same deception that Anne Askew fought against is still alive today. Many claim to follow Christ but are trapped in man-made traditions instead of biblical truth.

📖 2 Timothy 3:12 (KJV)
"Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution."
🚨 THE TRUTH: STANDING FOR CHRIST WILL ALWAYS BRING PERSECUTION!

✔️ Anne Askew was hated for exposing Catholic lies—true believers today will face similar opposition.
✔️ Satan does not want people to know the truth of Scripture—so he uses religious deception to keep them in bondage.
✔️ Many today still believe in the false Catholic Mass, purgatory, and praying to saints because they have never been shown the truth.
🔥 WILL YOU CHOOSE TO STAND FOR CHRIST, OR WILL YOU COMPROMISE?

📖 Matthew 10:33 (KJV)
"But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven."
🚨 TRUE FAITH MEANS CHOOSING CHRIST OVER TRADITION!

✔️ Sound doctrine is based on SCRIPTURE, not religious institutions.
✔️ Sound doctrine exalts CHRIST ALONE, not popes, saints, or Mary.
✔️ Sound doctrine teaches salvation by FAITH ALONE, not sacraments or rituals.
✔️ Sound doctrine preaches ONE MEDIATOR—Jesus Christ (1 Timothy 2:5), not priests or the Virgin Mary.
🔥 HOW TO MAKE SURE YOU ARE FOLLOWING TRUE BIBLICAL FAITH:

✔️ Test everything by Scripture—reject teachings that contradict the Bible (1 Thessalonians 5:21).
✔️ Reject any system that exalts human authority over God’s Word.
✔️ Stay close to Jesus through prayer and the Holy Spirit.
✔️ Be bold in defending the truth, just as Anne Askew was.

📖 Matthew 15:9 (KJV)
"But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men."

🚀 SHARE THIS BLOG—MANY ARE STILL DECEIVED BY FALSE TEACHINGS!
FINAL PRAYER—CHOOSE SCRIPTURE OVER RELIGIOUS TRADITION!

"Heavenly Father, I choose to follow the truth of Your Word, just as Anne Askew did. Open my eyes to recognize false teachings and give me wisdom to stand firm in the faith. I reject every man-made tradition that contradicts Scripture. I trust in Christ alone for salvation, and I will boldly defend the Gospel against deception. Fill me with the Holy Spirit and lead me in righteousness. In Jesus' mighty name, Amen!"

📖 Revelation 2:10 (KJV)
"Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life."
